title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha achieved a significant upset by defeating the World No. 2 Japanese star.
summary: The southpaw from Assam won 21-19, 21-18 to become the second Indian shuttler, after PV Sindhu, to beat the Japanese star.

title: Deepti Sharma Eyes 300+ Scores for India Women on Baroda Pitches
indian_angle: Indian cricketer Deepti Sharma discusses the team's batting strategy and expectations for high scores in upcoming matches.
summary: India hoarded a number of batting milestones and two 300+ scores the last time it played at the Kotambi Stadium and the brief will be no different against Zimbabwe.

title: Sheetal Secures Double Archery Gold, India's Athletics Dominates Para Games
indian_angle: Indian athletes, particularly Sheetal and the athletics contingent, are performing exceptionally well, contributing significantly to the nation's medal tally.
summary: India now has 88 medals in its kitty, including 21 gold, 26 silver and 41 bronze, while the biggest contributor remained para-athletics with 52 medals.

title: India Clinches First T20I Against New Zealand by Four Wickets
indian_angle: The Indian cricket team secured a victory in the opening T20I match against New Zealand.
summary: Chasing 225, India responded with 230 for six in 19.4 overs.

title: Anjanaben Bumbadiya Wins Gold, Jayanti Behera Silver at Para Games
indian_angle: Indian para-athletes Anjanaben Bumbadiya and Jayanti Behera secured gold and silver medals respectively in their events.
summary: Bumbadiya clocked 59.97sec to be the only runner in the four-athlete race with a sub one minute performance, while Behera won silver.
